question: Uday starts from Point A and drives 3 km towards south. He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, turns left and drives 5 km. He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km. He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point A again (all turns are 90° turns only unless specified)?
solution:
**Given: **

Uday starts from Point A and drives 3 km towards south.

He then takes a right turn, drives 2 km, turns left and drives 5 km.

He then takes a right turn and drives 3 km.

He takes a final right turn, drives 8 km and stops at Point P.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b3f1aef7f9784bb2fa29594616ac114d43da80ec290253861b09265af625afad.png] 

Thus, he drive5 km; East in order to reach Point A again.

Hence, the correct answer **"Option 3".**
